notes.title: (actually) Huge Update
notes.notes:
howdy!

I've finished up getting a decent amount of the basics down for the game.

This will be a small playtest, 1 with server to start and I can start up more if needed.  I don't think too many people will be on this playtest as it won't be blasted.

Each server can handle 14 players.  This can be adjusted as needed.  I'd rather have the server feel slightly empty instead of too crowded with people running around everywhere.

New Menu Map!

Map Updates:

 Map has been adjusted since the last playtest.
 Added Warehouse POI.
 New safezone in the mountains to the northwest.
 Random camps are placed throughout the map with more to be added later.


Weapon updates:

 Added Honey Badger
 Old weapons are available: Kar98, M4A1, M1982, AK74M.
 Attachments are being added/fixed in the next build.


Animation updates:

 Characters and weapons have new animations, some are a little buggy but will be fixed as I can get around to it.  I'm not very well versed in animating, so this is slightly lower priority.


Character Customization

 Character customization is coming soon.  I'm working on trying to get Unreal Engine's MetaHumans working with the kit.  It should offer way more customization options on top of having modular vests, helmets, etc.  This is brand new technology so it's still a work in progress to get it integrated.


Known Issues (more to be added):

 Some animations are glitchy for the character. These are being tweaked and fixed over time.
 If your weapon gets stuck in front of you in a weird way it's because you tried to sprint and jump too fast, doing this again should fix it.
 Vendor is missing items
 Some attachments may not attach to weapons.  This is high priority to fix.



Please visit our Discord and post any fun screenshots, feedback, bugs, etc!  

Remember: I'm a solo developer.  I'm doing this all by myself so if I don't respond back fast or at all I promise I am not ignoring you, there's just a lot going on! (Not on the Discord, it's dead, but in the background, ya know).

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
Compressed a lot of textures to improve general performance and decrease overall game size. It's going from 23 gb total to around 17 gb with this 11gb~ update.
 Bank system is functional and tied to your steam account.
 XP is persistent and should work between sessions now on any server. The UI will be fixed for this soon.

notes.title: 12/9 Update
notes.notes:
Vendors fixed
Campfires don't require fuel anymore
Fixed collision on certain objects to allow looting.
Zombies have more SFX
Guns have reduced spread until further distance now, this will be tuned more
You now create tracks through snow. This should be replicated and you'll be able to see other's tracks through the snow.
Adjusted cash spawns
Fixed anti-aliasing ghosting (hopefully)
Replaced ammo spawns with ammo boxes that spawn ammo in them at random between 5-120 bullets.
New rocks
Smoothed out some of the terrain
More stuff is able to have snow on it or be wet.
Ambient sounds should be more reliable now.

notes.title: Lighting Update
notes.notes:
More lights have been added and should turn on/off during the day/night cycle.

Night time has been shortened as well.

notes.title: Movement Update
notes.notes: Some movement, animation updates and footstep sound modifications.

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/9/2023
notes.notes:
Safe Zone Update

 More items
 Safe Zone Added, you cannot deal damage to other players here.
 Vendors added to Safe Zone where you can sell or buy most items.  Prices are subject to change any time as they can be adjusted dynamically.
 Zombies have sound now, more variety coming later here
 Updates to Map and Compass. Let me know if there are issues with this.
 Random character models added.  If you relog you will have a random character model again.  Soon you'll be able to select what model you want before loading in.


Known Issues:

 VOIP doesn't work
 Experience window sometimes doesn't load but it's still tracking.
 Vendors have placeholder models for now.
